stories.title: Fidelity inflow of $310M rescues Bitcoin ETFs from a rough week
stories.summary: Fidelity's Bitcoin ETF pulled in roughly $310 million, according to CryptoSlate, offsetting broader weakness that had put US spot Bitcoin ETFs on track for a poor week. The surge points to renewed institutional demand even as sentiment elsewhere soured. The report did not break out flows from other issuers.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a real-time gauge of institutional appetite for Bitcoin, and a single fund's rebound can mask or offset broader weakness across the category.
whatToWatch: Whether other issuers post inflows in the coming week
Full weekly net flow tally across spot Bitcoin ETFs
questions: What specifically drove Fidelity's surge?
Is this a one-off or the start of a sustained trend?

sources.title: Fidelity surge brings in $310M BTC saving Bitcoin ETFs from a disastrous week

stories.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
stories.summary: REX has launched a new ETF offering 2x leveraged exposure to Strive, a company that holds Bitcoin as a treasury asset, per Cointelegraph. The product amplifies bets on Strive's stock rather than Bitcoin itself. Fund size and ticker details were not included in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Leveraged single-stock ETFs tied to Bitcoin treasury companies extend crypto-adjacent speculation into traditional markets, adding a new layer of risk for retail investors.
whatToWatch: Early trading volume and demand for the fund
Whether other issuers launch similar leveraged products on treasury firms
questions: How will the fund's performance track Strive's underlying Bitcoin holdings versus its stock price?

stories.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
stories.summary: Bastion has received conditional approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to operate as a national trust bank, according to Cointelegraph. The approval is conditional, meaning Bastion must still meet specific requirements before the charter is finalized. The report did not detail those remaining conditions.
stories.whyItMatters: A national trust bank charter would give a crypto-focused firm federally regulated banking status, a milestone few digital-asset companies have reached.
whatToWatch: Whether Bastion satisfies the OCC's remaining conditions
Timeline for the charter to become final
questions: What conditions has the OCC attached?
What services will Bastion offer once fully chartered?

stories.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase in filing for US stock perpetual futures
stories.summary: Prediction market Kalshi has filed for permission to offer perpetual futures on US stocks, following a similar filing from Coinbase, according to Cointelegraph. Perpetual futures are derivatives with no expiry date, common in crypto trading but new to US equities. The report does not specify the regulator involved or an expected approval timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: If approved, perpetual futures on US stocks would bring a crypto-native trading structure into mainstream equity markets, a notable regulatory and product crossover.
whatToWatch: Regulatory response to the filings
Whether other exchanges follow with similar filings
questions: Which regulator must approve these products?
How would stock perpetuals differ from existing equity derivatives?

stories.title: How the Clarity Act's defeat handed the SEC and CFTC the wheel on crypto
stories.summary: Decrypt reports that the failure of the Clarity Act leaves the SEC and CFTC in control of shaping crypto market structure policy, absent new legislation. Without the bill, oversight defaults back to the two agencies' existing frameworks and rulemaking. The report does not detail specific next steps from either agency.
stories.whyItMatters: Congressional inaction means crypto market structure rules will be set agency by agency rather than by statute, adding uncertainty for exchanges and issuers.
whatToWatch: SEC and CFTC rulemaking or guidance in the absence of the Clarity Act
Any renewed legislative push for market structure clarity
questions: Will Congress attempt another version of the bill?

stories.title: Bitcoin's sharpest rally in two years ran almost entirely on short liquidations
stories.summary: Decrypt reports that Bitcoin's recent rally, its sharpest in two years, was driven largely by forced liquidations of short positions rather than fresh buying demand. That suggests the price move may reflect leveraged traders being squeezed rather than organic conviction. The report does not give exact liquidation figures or price levels.
stories.whyItMatters: A rally fueled mainly by short squeezes rather than spot demand is less likely to hold, an important distinction for anyone reading recent price action as a trend change.
whatToWatch: Whether the rally holds once liquidations subside
Spot market demand data in the coming days
questions: How much of the move was liquidation-driven versus organic buying?

stories.title: Zcash's 100% rally above $1,500 pushes Grayscale's ZEC ETF within $85M of $1B
